cases.name: ocs_defaults
cases.source: Independently re-derived Bondi accretion formula from the page's own stated closed form (mdot = 4*pi*(GM)^2*rho/(sigma^2+c_s^2)^1.5, He-corrected rho=1.2*n_e*m_p, L=eta*mdot*c^2, concealment ceiling = L_lim/leak); args = (mbh_Msun, n_e_cm-3, sigma_kms, c_s_kms, eta, L_lim_Lsun, leak_frac) at OCS clusterParams defaults (mbh=2e4, n_e=0.23, sigma=18.2 -- Paper E's 21 km/s not used here, this is the site's own default). Verdict reproduces the page's stated finding that concealment binds by roughly two orders of magnitude (1.07e6 / 1e4 = 107x) over supply.

cases.name: haberle_lower_bound
cases.source: Same independently re-derived formula, at the Häberle et al. 2024 lower-bound mass (8200 Msun).
